node.title: Upstream v4 partial relative order-32 explanation theorem
node.closure: immutable upstream theorem harvest with exact row replay
node.statement: For either deployed adjacent MCA row and any 32 distinct bad slopes with maximal supports and selected exact m-subsupports, every non-global-affine explanation outside the common-support, pure-locator, denominator-root, and scalar-locator rational-profile cells has slope degree 18 through 31 and two-cover complexity chi at least 3m-k+3: 2299571 on KoalaBear and 2299499 on Mersenne-31. If every residual 32-subset is affine or rational, then all bad slopes lie in one coherent structure or a 31-overlap enters the quantified near-sunflower branch. This is classification, not spread, large-owner, exception, or row closure.
